contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->one(u: User|u.UserID = uid and
		u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->one(c: BookCopy|c.Barcode = barcode and
		c.IsReserved = false) and
		Loan.allInstances()->one(l: Loan|l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
		l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
		l.IsReturned = false and
		l.LoanedUser.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
		l.LoanedCopy.IsReserved = false and
		l.DueDate.isAfter(Today) and
		l.OverDueFee = 0.0 and
		if l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then l.RenewedTimes<3 
		else l.RenewedTimes<6 
		endif )
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		Loan.allInstances()->one(l: Loan|l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
		l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
		l.IsReturned = false and
		l.RenewedTimes = l.RenewedTimes@pre+1 and
		l.RenewDate = Today and
		if l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then if Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = l.LoanedUser.UserID and
		s.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR) 
		then l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre.After(20) 
		else if Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = l.LoanedUser.UserID and
		s.Programme = Programme::MASTER) 
		then l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre.After(40) 
		else l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre.After(60) 
		endif  
		endif  
		else l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre.After(60) 
		endif )
}
